meta_title: Aaru · A private shelf for films, shows, anime and books
meta_description: Track films, shows, anime and books in one private library. Import from Trakt, IMDb, Letterboxd and Goodreads. Export any time.
hero_title: Everything you watch and read, on one shelf.
hero_body: Track films, shows, anime and books in one calm library. Private by default. Bring your history, leave whenever you like.
hero_platforms: Coming to iPhone, iPad and Mac
mascot_alt: Aaru's mascot, a small teal bird carrying a stack of books and a film reel
import_body: Import from the services you already use. Export everything, any time, for free.
shelf_title: One shelf for all of it
shelf_body: Films, shows, anime and books share one search, one library and four plain statuses.
private_body: Nobody sees your shelf unless you invite them. No public profile, no global feed, no ads.
week_body: Up next, air times and a week grid for the shows and anime you follow.
apple_title: Made for iPhone, iPad and Mac
apple_body: A native app with widgets for what is next, and a web app on the same library.
faq_public_a: No. Everything is private. Sharing, when it arrives, is opt-in and friends only.
faq_export_q: Can I take my data out?
faq_export_a: Yes. You can export your whole library as CSV or JSON at any time, and export will never be a paid feature.
faq_import_a: Trakt, IMDb, Letterboxd, Goodreads, TV Time, MyAnimeList, AniList and a Pogdesign CAT show list.
faq_anime_a: Yes. Anime is first-class, with AniList and MyAnimeList ids and episode-level progress.
faq_when_a: Aaru is in private beta on iPhone and Mac. The App Store release follows once testers have used it end to end.
faq_price_a: Pricing is not final. Your library, your export and your statistics will never sit behind a paywall.
footer_line: A calm place where stories live.
